propositions: Six in-scope modules (inbound_differ.py, apply_inbound_records.py, det_floor.py, executor.py, prompts.py, init.py) sit at 786–800 LOC and trigger hard CI failure on any edit.
Splits must follow logical architectural boundaries and existing call-graph seams; resulting files must be 100–500+ LOC each with real headroom (target 720 LOC or below, not 799–800).
No test modifications allowed purely to accommodate splits; behavior must be preserved; complexity ratchet must show zero new or increased entries.
The 800-LOC limit in .github/module-size-limit.txt is locked with no allowlist; it cannot be raised and must remain byte-identical after all splits.
Census is stale after 45 commits merged in session; re-measurement against current origin/main is required before selecting extraction targets.
